adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, after a successful parse it forcibly sets `refresh_token` when missing: `if (!refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token) { refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"; }`. In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh flow now does `const tokenResponse = parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)` and then merges `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) };` before persisting to Prisma. If Microsoft (or the sync endpoint’s minimum schema path) returns no `refresh_token`, this merge will overwrite the real stored refresh token with the literal string "refresh_token", causing future refreshes to fail and corrupting stored credentials. This is directly introduced by the new helper behavior and the spread merge.
